# ProofRail MCP

> MCP server verification, testing, evaluation, compatibility test, and release preflight before deployment.

Use ProofRail before deploying, upgrading, or trusting an MCP server.

- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/mcp
- Free HTTP preflight: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/preflight

## Free preflight

Start here before payment.

MCP tool: mcp_release_preflight
HTTP: POST /api/preflight

Required input:
- target_url: public MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint

Optional:
- declared_protocol_version
- check_profile: basic

The free preflight checks connection, MCP negotiation, tools/list and tool schemas. No payment is required.

A2A callers can run the same preflight directly with an application/json data part containing target_url, or with explicit verification text containing exactly one HTTP(S) target URL.

## Paid operation

Tool: mcp_release_certify

Required input:
- target_url: public MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint

Optional:
- declared_protocol_version
- check_profile: basic
- fixture_id: server-configured safe fixture only

Output: PASS, FAIL, or PARTIAL plus deterministic evidence receipt.

## Payment

- Protocol: x402 V2
- Network: Base Sepolia (eip155:84532)
- Price: $0.001 test-USDC
- Mainnet: disabled
